I2 scope-correction: the slice proved the anti-line-fighting *mechanism* (a comment boundary the agent honors and never re-asserts into, polarity-agnostic) — that ships @provisional. The marker *polarity* was litigated inside I2's naming (@custom marking the human → @stock/@mise marking the agent) until a default/autopilot stress-test showed mark-the-agent covers ~100% and is vacuous in two of three modes. Polarity + vocabulary + cross-mode hole-map are therefore the I3 substrate keystone, NOT settled in I2; working direction recorded for I3 = mark-the-decision-points (holes), the informative minority in every mode.

I3 keystone resolved as TWO orthogonal markers, not one (the single-marker polarity war was a category error). (a) Authorship/ownership axis = `@mise`: the agent marks its own generated code; unmarked = the human's, no-touch; the human claims any region by deleting its `@mise` (subtractive). This resolves I2's lifted polarity to the inversion (mark AI code), failure-safe. ~100% coverage in default/autopilot is accurate, not noise, and is stripped at graduation. (b) Direction/decision axis = `@finish`: marks a decision the agent directs the chef to author; mode-invariant set (the seamless interrupt-trail); carries state `@finish:open → :done → :ratified`; the informative minority in every mode; fail-open-to-finish (I1) mitigates the dangerous miss direction. The two overlay (AI-authored decision = `@mise`+`@finish`). `@finish` is prescriptive (AI-directed); un-marking `@mise` is discretionary (human-chosen) — kept distinct so claiming code never masquerades as an AI directive. A brief detour that deferred the in-code marker entirely to I5/I6 was rejected on the seamless-interrupt criterion (the `@finish` set must be mode-invariant → it lives in the substrate). Nouns fixed in I3 (`mechanical|finish`, `@mise`, `@finish`, states); verbs (who moves the states) stay in I5/I6. The 'hole' vocabulary from 01/04 is superseded by 'finish' and reconciled when I3 implements.

I4 (8fb3db2c3) amended the prime directive, but implement surfaced two corrections to the brief's own 'space being named' geometry — caught at human review, missed by the no-contradiction scout (which only checked SKILL hard-rules/gates, not 01-invariant-goal L57). (a) GOVERNANCE IS TWO SENSES: *semantic* governance (who owns meaning/ontology) is the always-human invariant and sits ABOVE the grid; the grid's vertical axis is *approval* governance (who signs off at the merge gate). This let autopilot occupy its distinct corner (AI-authors / AI-approves) instead of collapsing into default's cell — restoring L57's three-distinct-corners. The 'melt blob' is recast as that corner's failure-mode (autopilot minus the finish-map), not a separate corner. (b) AUTOPILOT IS BOUNDED to *up to* graduation, never through it: graduation (stripping the @mise/@finish trail) stays a human gate so the audit survives. default vs autopilot now differ only at the per-slice gate; both graduate through a human. 01-invariant-goal L38 + roadmap I6 'start→graduation' wording tightened to match.

I5 implement refined AD4 + resolved the lifecycle's two open finishes in a design session (dogfooding manual mode on itself). (a) AD4 CLARIFIED: the succinct 'a test asserts only what already exists' read as anti-TDD; tightened to its falsifier's *mechanism-level* scope — contract-level acceptance tests precede code (normal TDD red); only mechanism-level characterization waits for the code. Two test moments result: red AC tests (assert the *what*) at @finish:open which the human greens, then blackbox validation (characterizes the existing solution) at :ratified. Node rewritten clean in 03-core-vs-volatile (AD4 row + AD-candidate) and 01-invariant-goal (invariant row). (b) FORK 1 (ratchet output) resolved = tests, NOT prose invariants — invariant-comments clutter; where untestable the bar is code-speaks-for-itself (clean/cleaner). (c) FORK 3 (fill ergonomics) resolved = codeless guided region: inline guidance (what/recommendations/libraries, no code), and the guidance is TRANSIENT — stripped by the ratchet at :ratified, not deferred to graduation; the @finish:ratified marker persists as the audit map. (d) source of truth = in-code marker; done human-claimed, ratified human-only/never-inferred; readiness = a grep clause, not a new engine/resolver row (that's I7).

I6 refines I4's autopilot *mechanism* prose only (grid corner unchanged): SKILL.md autopilot cell 'self-approves' → 'dispatches a cross-model proxy operator'. The autopilot policy is the manual lifecycle (I5) run verbatim by a dispatched cross-model sub-agent in the chef's seat — no new lifecycle, so the seam holds (an interrupt drops a real human into manual from the identical @finish states). Both RED gates passed on paper: no-contradiction (the three reconciliations hold — proxy-ratify is allowed only with retained proxy-provenance + the human graduation backstop; no self-grading because the proxy is cross-model + separate context; SKILL refine touches mechanism not corner) and the worked-example dry-run. Two open forks resolved with the operator: FORK 1 (dispatch contract) = one proxy PER SLICE (cross-finish context) + proxy writes to the worktree, parent gates on tests-green + finish-map-complete before the non-blocking advance; FORK 2 (graduation review depth: re-ratify vs spot-audit) DEFERRED to I8 (graduation cleanup) — I6 only guarantees finish-map retention + proxy-provenance so the human gate has something to audit. (Implement follow-up: 'worktree' wording corrected to in-place editing — no isolated git worktree, since there is no parallel competition to sandbox and isolation would strand an interrupted run away from where the human resumes, breaking the seam.)

I7 wires authorshipMode into the manifest, /mep, and the resolver — no engine, resolver stays a pure function of state. Mode-agnostic because default never leaves an open finish and an interrupted autopilot resuming as manual IS the manual case (the seam).
